title: Evaluating Variance in Visual Question Answering Benchmarks

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance on standard multiple-choice evaluations (predicting option letters like A, B, C, D) against Cloze-style evaluations (predicting the negative log-likelihood of the full text options) to expose inherent LLM preferences for specific option letters.

Evaluating models in a 'blind mode' where image tokens are completely removed during training to measure whether the models rely on internal textual world knowledge rather than actual visual understanding to answer questions.
